caveat: in-sample: θ (and, for a fine-tuned model, T and the epoch) were chosen on these val messages, so these numbers are not held-out estimates

calibration.brier: mean over every (message, tag) pair of (p - y)^2; the per-message sum over 48 tags is 48 x this
calibration.nll: mean binary cross-entropy over every (message, tag) pair, p clipped to [1e-12, 1 - 1e-12]
calibration.classwise_ece: Kull et al. 2019 Eq. 4: per tag, the sum over the 15 equal-width bins of |sum of y - sum of p| / n; averaged over all 48 tags, zero-support tags included
calibration.bins: 15 equal-width bins [k/15, (k+1)/15), p = 1.0 in the last bin (Guo et al. 2017, M = 15)

definitions.confidence: message confidence = sum over the 48 tags of log q, q = p if p >= θ (predicted) else 1 - p: the model's probability that every tag decision is right, assuming tag independence
definitions.coverage: keep the k = ceil(c * n / 100) most confident messages, k computed as (c * n + 99) // 100; ties in confidence keep split-file order (stable sort)
definitions.aurc: mean over k = 1..n of 1 - exact-match rate of the k most confident messages (Geifman et al. 2019); lower is better
definitions.false_positive: a counted message has no gold tag among the scored columns; it is a false positive when at least one scored column is predicted at θ (P >= θ). No-intent: all 48 columns. Out-of-domain: the 22 banking-only columns (the manifest's ood_scoring_tags)
definitions.wilson: 95% Wilson score interval, z = 1.959963984540054, no continuity correction

theta.tie_break: closest to 0.5; between two equally close points, the lower θ
closest to 0.5; between two equally close points, the lower θ
